# The Holy Supper

> Pre-filled Communion Cups for churches — bread and juice sealed together. Made in Italy, shipped across Europe and worldwide. Helping pastors and ministry leaders keep Communion simple, hygienic and focused on Christ.

The Holy Supper designs and manufactures individual, pre-filled Communion Cups (also known as Lord's Supper cups, Eucharist cups, bicchierini per la Santa Cena) for evangelical and traditional churches. Product launch is upcoming; the site collects pricing requests and waiting-list signups in six languages (English, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German).

## Pages

- [Home (French)](/fr): Coupes de communion pré-remplies.
- [Home (German)](/de): Vorgefüllte Abendmahlskelche.
- [Request Pricing](/en/contact): Contact form for churches to request tailored pricing and information.
- [Join the Waiting List](/en/waiting-list): Priority list for launch pricing on pre-filled Communion Cups.
